test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the voice of the following sentence.

The satellite has been launched successfully by ISRO.

options.text: ISRO have launched the satellite successfully.
ISRO has launched the satellite successfully.
ISRO has launch the satellite successfully.
ISRO has launched the satellite successful.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The satellite has been launched successfully by ISRO."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "ISRO" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "has been launched" to "has launched" (present perfect active).
 
• Ensure the object "the satellite" remains after the verb.
 
• Keep the adverb "successfully" intact for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"ISRO has launched the satellite successfully."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"ISRO have launched the satellite successfully." – Incorrect subject-verb agreement (use "has" instead of "have").
 
• **Option 3: **"ISRO has launch the satellite successfully." – Incorrect verb form (use "launched" instead of "launch").
 
• **Option 4: **"ISRO has launched the satellite successful." – Incorrect adverb usage (use "successfully" instead of "successful").
